title: Common finite open-closed local-model tree
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be any commutative condensed ring, $X$ a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme, and $(M_a)_{a\in\operatorname{Fin}(m)}$ a finite family of $\Lambda_X$-module sheaves [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Suppose every $M_a$ is constant-model constructible [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. There exists a finite qcqs open-closed tree rooted at $X$ [def-sfb-qcqs-open-closed-tree] such that for every leaf path $p:S\to X$ and every $a$, the actual pullback $p^*M_a$ has a finite constant scalar local model. Empty leaves and an empty family are allowed. No admissibility or cohomological-dimension hypothesis is assumed.

source.place: Paragraph (2), first paragraph, geometric common-refinement step; step 2 of lem-sfb-finite-constructible-complex-heart-cd. The finite constructible-partition refinement is Stacks Tag 09Y4; no analytic coefficient estimate is asserted here.

proof.text: Choose a finite constructible stratification for each module, using that X is qcqs. Apply the finite open-closed refinement theorem to these finite partitions, retaining its actual factoring maps on nonempty leaves.

proof.text: Each factoring map pulls back the corresponding finite constant local model with its same finite scalar presentation. The pullback compositor identifies the resulting module with restriction from X along the actual leaf path. Empty leaves use their empty covering family, whose local-model condition is vacuous.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finite_constant_local_model_tree
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (m : ℕ)
    (M : Fin m →
      Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (hM : ∀ a, IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X (M a)) :
    ∃ tree : QcqsOpenClosedTree X,
      ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) (p : tree.Path S), p.IsLeaf → ∀ a : Fin m,
        HasFiniteConstantLocalModel Λ S ((CondensedRing.upperStar Λ p.toRoot).obj (M a))
